description_en: Modifies the Cloud Assistant service configurations
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-cloud-assistant-settings --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --setting-type SessionManagerDelivery --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCloudAssistantSettings

parameters.help_en:
The service configuration type. Valid values:
SessionManagerDelivery: session operation log delivery.
InvocationDelivery: task execution log delivery.
AgentUpgradeConfig: Cloud Assistant Agent upgrade configuration.
SessionManagerConfig: Cloud Assistant SessionManager configuration
parameters.help_zh:
服务配置类型。当前取值范围：
SessionManagerDelivery：会话操作记录投递。
InvocationDelivery：任务执行记录投递。
AgentUpgradeConfig：云助手Agent升级配置。
SessionManagerConfig: 云助手SessionManager配置
parameters.name: setting_type

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
fields.help_zh: OSS存储空间名称
fields.name: bucket_name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable delivery to OSS. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否开启投递到OSS功能。默认值：false
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en:
The OSS encryption algorithm. Valid values:
AES256
SM4
fields.help_zh:
OSS加密算法，可选值：
AES256
SM4
fields.name: encryption_algorithm

fields.help_en: The ID of the customer master key (CMK) when the encryption method is set to KMS
fields.help_zh: 加密方式为KMS时，用户的主密钥CMK ID
fields.name: encryption_key_id

fields.help_en:
The OSS encryption method. Valid values:
Inherit: inherits the encryption method of the bucket.
OssManaged: OSS-managed encryption.
KMS: Key Management Service (KMS) encryption
fields.help_zh:
OSS加密方式，可选值：
Inherit：继承 Bucket；
OssManaged：OSS 完全托管；
KMS：KMS加密
fields.name: encryption_type

fields.help_en:
The directory prefix of the OSS bucket. The following limits apply:
The prefix cannot exceed 254 characters in length.
The prefix cannot start with a forward slash (/) or a backslash ().

Note: Set this parameter to an empty string ("") if no directory prefix is required. If a prefix was previously configured and is no longer needed, set this parameter to an empty string ("") to clear it
fields.help_zh:
OSS存储空间目录前缀。约束如下：
长度不得超过 254 个字符。
不能以正斜线（/）或者反斜线（\）开头。

注：传入""表示不需要目录前缀；若之前设置过，而当前不再需要目录前缀可传入""清空
fields.name: prefix

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable delivery to SLS.
Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否开启投递到SLS功能。
默认值：false
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS Logstore
fields.help_zh: SLS日志库名称
fields.name: logstore_name

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS project
fields.help_zh: SLS项目名称
fields.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The Simple Log Service (SLS) delivery configuration
parameters.name: sls_delivery_config

fields.help_en:
The list of time windows during which upgrades are allowed. The time can be specified down to the minute. The default time zone is UTC.

The interval between time windows cannot be less than 1 hour.

Format: Start time (HH:mm)-End time (HH:mm).

Example: [
"02:00-03:00",
"05:00-06:00"
]
This indicates that upgrades are allowed daily from 02:00 to 03:00 and from 05:00 to 06:00 in the UTC time zone
fields.help_zh:
允许升级的时间段列表，可精确到分，默认为 UTC 时区。

各时间段的间隔不能小于1小时。

格式：开始时间(HH:mm)-结束时间(HH:mm)。

如[
"02:00-03:00",
"05:00-06:00"
]
代表在 UTC 时区的每天2点-3点、5点-6点允许升级
fields.name: allowed_upgrade_window

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the Cloud Assistant Agent checks for updates and performs an upgrade immediately upon startup. Default value: true.

This parameter takes effect only when the Cloud Assistant Agent version meets the following minimum requirements:

Windows: 2.1.4.1065

Linux: 2.2.4.1065
fields.help_zh:
是否在云助手 Agent 启动时立即检查版本和进行更新。默认值：true。

确保云助手Agent版本不低于以下版本才会生效：

Windows：2.1.4.1065

Linux：2.2.4.1065
fields.name: bootstrap_upgrade

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to prevent the Cloud Assistant Agent from checking for and performing updates. Default value: false.

This parameter takes effect only when the Cloud Assistant Agent version meets the following minimum requirements:

Windows: 2.1.4.1065

Linux: 2.2.4.1065
fields.help_zh:
是否禁止云助手 Agent 检查和进行更新。默认值：false。

确保云助手Agent版本不低于以下版本才会生效：

Windows：2.1.4.1065

Linux：2.2.4.1065
fields.name: disable_upgrade

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the custom Agent upgrade configuration. If this parameter is set to false, the system attempts to upgrade the Agent every 30 minutes by default.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否开启自定义Agent升级配置。如设置为false，默认保持每30分钟尝试升级一次。

默认值：false
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en:
The time zone for the allowed upgrade time windows. Default value: UTC.
The time zone can be specified in the following formats:
Full time zone name, such as Asia/Shanghai or America/Los_Angeles.
GMT offset from Greenwich Mean Time, such as GMT+8:00 or GMT-7:00. Leading zeros are not supported for the hour value
fields.help_zh:
允许升级时间段的时区。默认为 UTC 时区。
时区支持以下两种形式：
时区全称： 如Asia/Shanghai（中国/上海时间）、America/Los_Angeles（美国/洛杉矶时间）等。
时区相对于格林威治时间的偏移量： 如GMT+8:00（东八区）、GMT-7:00（西七区）等。小时位不支持添加前导零
fields.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Assistant Agent upgrade configuration
parameters.name: agent_upgrade_config

fields.help_en:
The maximum CPU usage allowed for the Cloud Assistant Agent main process.

Unit: percentage.

Valid values: 10 to 95.

Default value: 20
fields.help_zh:
云助手Agent主进程最大允许的CPU占用限制。

单位：百分比。

取值范围：10-95。

默认值：20
fields.name: cpu_limit

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the script file in the Cloud Assistant directory after command execution is complete.
Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
命令执行完成后，是否保留脚本文件到云助手目录。
默认值：false
fields.name: keep_script_file

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of Cloud Assistant log files to retain.
Default value: 30.
Minimum value: 7.
Maximum value: 365
fields.help_zh:
云助手日志文件的最大保存数量。
默认：30。
最小值：7。
最大值：365
fields.name: log_file_count_limit

fields.help_en:
The maximum size of a single Cloud Assistant log file. You must specify the unit (B|KB|MB).
Default value: 100MB.
Minimum value: 10MB.
Maximum value: 1024MB
fields.help_zh:
单个云助手日志文件的大小限制，必须指定单位（B|KB|MB）。
默认值：100MB。
最小值：10MB。
最大值：1024MB
fields.name: log_size_limit

fields.help_en:
The maximum memory usage allowed for the Cloud Assistant Agent main process. You must specify the unit (B|KB|MB).
Default value: 50MB.
Minimum value: 35MB.
Maximum value: 1024MB
fields.help_zh:
云助手Agent主进程最大允许的内存占用限制，必须指定单位（B|KB|MB）。
默认值：50MB。
最小值：35MB。
最大值：1024MB
fields.name: memory_limit

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of consecutive times that CPU or memory resources usage can exceed the limit before the Cloud Assistant Agent automatically stops running.
Default value: 3.
Minimum value: 3
fields.help_zh:
CPU或内存资源占用连续超限次数上限，达到上限后云助手Agent自动终止运行。
默认值：3。
最小值：3
fields.name: overload_limit

parameters.help_en:
The Cloud Assistant resource usage configuration. This parameter takes effect only when the Cloud Assistant Agent version meets the following minimum requirements:

Windows: 2.1.4.1065

Linux: 2.2.4.1065
parameters.help_zh:
云助手资源占用配置。确保云助手Agent版本不低于以下版本才会生效：

Windows：2.1.4.1065

Linux：2.2.4.1065
parameters.name: resource_usage_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Cloud Assistant session feature. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Note:
Enabling or disabling the session feature takes effect across all regions
fields.help_zh:
云助手会话功能开关。取值范围：
true: 开启；
false: 关闭。

注意事项：
会话功能开启/关闭对全部地域生效
fields.name: session_manager_enabled

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Assistant session feature configuration
parameters.name: session_manager_config
